changes: Add instance_binding_refs to every CAV2-D60 Project record.
Add a closed Project-owned RecursiveInstanceBinding registry shaped by CAV2-D64-SCHEMA.
Add explicit Project-binding residue so unresolved candidate endpoints cannot enter the binding registry.
Separate check-only validation from explicit receipt materialization.
migration: Existing Project records migrate with instance_binding_refs set to an empty array unless exact registered binding IDs already exist.
rollback: Remove the three new package files, restore cav2-project/v1 records, and remove instance_binding_refs only before any binding ID is registered.
claim_ceiling: Schema and ontology readiness only; no Project, binding, adoption, conformance, implementation, execution, or enforcement authority is created.
